agent_note: Third-person present-tense narration (Alix/Josie strand) is the dominant mode: 10 of 11 event quotes are present, all specific character/moment. A second strand of first-person conversational passages reads as interview/podcast transcript speech rather than narration -- quotation marks survive only partially in this book (intact in q08239, one stray open mark in q08215), so those were bucketed as dialogue on register signals: vocative ('Nathan'), direct address, tag questions, and listener-directed hedges ('I know how bad this sounds', 'You know,'). q08224 confirms an in-world true-crime podcast, which supports the transcript reading. Flip risk concentrated in q08221, q08219, q08225: if that strand is first-person retrospective narration instead of speech, three past event quotes would be added and the book would read dual rather than simultaneous.
